title: Supportive Help Selection Screen

Title: Supportive Help Selection Screen
Context: Task clarification screen for the 'Doer' (fixer) in the HoneyDo2Done app, designed to facilitate non-judgmental communication when help is needed.
Description of the screen: A supportive 'holdup' selection screen with a deep charcoal background and a very subtle amber glow. At the top, a back arrow and the title 'What\'s the holdup?' in white. The main content consists of three large, vertically stacked cards in dark gray (#1A1A1A) with 12px rounded corners and subtle borders. Card 1 (Diagnosis): A question mark icon, title 'I don\'t know how to diagnose this', and subtitle 'Help me figure out what\'s wrong'. Card 2 (Tools): A wrench icon, title 'I don\'t have the right tools', and subtitle 'Help me find what I need'. Card 3 (Assistance): A two-people icon, title 'I need another pair of hands', and subtitle 'This is a two-person job'. The layout is spacious and feels supportive and collaborative, emphasizing the therapeutic and helpful nature of the app.
Platform: web
Form factor: desktop
